issues.what: Option C has an unnatural trailing filler word 'component' breaking parallel structure
issues.detail: Option C: 'etcd -> kubelet -> kube-apiserver -> kube-proxy -> kube-controller-manager component' has the word 'component' appended. Options A, B, and D all use clean component-name-only arrow-separated lists without trailing descriptors. This makes C look artificially padded and stylistically inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'component' from the end of option C so it reads 'etcd -> kubelet -> kube-apiserver -> kube-proxy -> kube-controller-manager'.

issues.what: Correct answer D is dramatically longer than all distractors (~65% over average)
issues.detail: Option D (correct, answer index 3): '`kubectl drain` refuses to evict DaemonSet-managed Pods and requires the `--ignore-daemonsets` flag to proceed' is ~106 chars. Options A (~63 chars), B (~61 chars), C (~68 chars) average ~64 chars. The correct answer is ~65% longer, far exceeding the 30% outlier threshold. The most-detailed-is-correct pattern is a well-known test-taking giveaway.
issues.suggestion: Shorten D to roughly match distractor lengths, e.g. 'D. `kubectl drain` skips DaemonSet-managed Pods unless `--ignore-daemonsets` is passed' (~80 chars). Or pad distractors with comparable detail.

issues.what: Distractors B/C/D have inconsistent trailing filler words absent from correct answer A
issues.detail: Option A (correct): '`scheduler_scheduling_attempt_duration_seconds`' has no trailing descriptor. Options B and C each end with 'metric name', and D ends with 'metric name type'. These filler words were likely added to pad length but are absent from the correct answer, making A the only naturally formatted option. This stylistic inconsistency serves as a subtle giveaway.
issues.suggestion: Remove trailing filler words from B, C, D so all four options are clean backtick-formatted metric names: B '`kubelet_pod_start_duration_seconds`', C '`apiserver_request_duration_seconds`', D '`etcd_request_duration_seconds`'.

issues.what: Option D claims globalDefault is not a valid field, an easily eliminated distractor
issues.detail: Option D states '`globalDefault` is not a recognized valid field in the PriorityClass resource spec'. This is trivially false for anyone with basic PriorityClass knowledge, and the question stem itself uses the field name as if it were valid, effectively reducing the question to 3 choices.
issues.suggestion: Replace D with a more plausible distractor, e.g. 'The `globalDefault` field requires all existing Pods to be restarted before the new default takes effect on them'.

issues.what: Only the correct answer contains a concrete kubectl command in backticks
issues.detail: Option D (correct) includes '`kubectl get nodes`' with backtick formatting. Options A, B, and C are all abstract prose descriptions without any specific commands. Test-takers trained to pick the most specific or actionable option will gravitate to D on stylistic grounds alone.
issues.suggestion: Add a concrete command to at least one distractor, e.g. change A to 'Skip pre-deployment checks and rely on `kubectl rollout undo` for recovery if issues arise'.
